title: Modern Neovim
description: APIs and defaults from Neovim 0.11: diagnostics, window borders and the new LSP config.

levels.title: Speak up, diagnostics
levels.description: Since 0.11, diagnostics no longer show inline by default. This config turns it off on purpose. Turn it back on.
levels.hint: vim.diagnostic.config takes a table of settings; virtual_text = true shows messages at the end of the line.

levels.title: Rounded everywhere
levels.description: Give every floating window a rounded border with one option.
levels.hint: 'winborder' (0.11) sets the default border for all floats.

levels.title: Find the root
levels.description: Every language server should treat the folder with .git as the project root. This config says .hg.

probes.description: the shared LSP config uses .git as a root marker

levels.hint: vim.lsp.config("*", ...) sets defaults for every server, no server needed. Change hg to git.
